query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('source_pages',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages s JOIN public.books b ON b.id=s.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND s.source_page BETWEEN 754 AND 758),'topics',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.topics t JOIN public.chapters c ON c.id=t.chapter_id JOIN public.books b ON b.id=c.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND c.slug='europe' AND t.slug IN ('international-organizations-exam-boundary-754','eu-brexit-boundary-755','eu-nato-euro-boundary-756','gsp-schengen-boundary-757','brics-rcep-boundary-758')),'facts',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 754 AND 758),'notes',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 754 AND 758),'mcqs',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 754 AND 758),'mcq_options',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id=o.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 754 AND 758),'verifications',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 754 AND 758),'flashcards',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0754-0758:%'),'search_documents',0) AS batch_integrity LIMIT 1;
